answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proof of unique personhood combined with staked compute resources prevents Sybil attacks. If a malicious actor tries to flood the network with fake identities akin to blades of grass in a meadow facing a sudden gale, the economic cost becomes prohibitive. Each validated agent must lock up native tokens on a verifiable digital terrace, ensuring that generating thousands of fraudulent nodes requires exponential capital outlay and computational proof of distinct hardware, neutralizing the exploit.
